events.title: Audrey Tang co-launches g0v civic hacking movement
events.summary: Audrey Tang helped launch Taiwan's g0v (gov-zero) civic hacking movement in December 2012 — open-source tools for government transparency.
events.about: g0v produced open data dashboards, petition systems, and disaster-response apps — a model for civic tech worldwide. Tang's work bridged hacker culture and public-sector reform in Taiwan.

narrative.whyChosen: g0v became one of the most influential civic hacking communities globally.
narrative.whyImportant: It showed how volunteer developers could improve democratic institutions with open data.
narrative.problemSolved: Government data and services were opaque and hard for citizens to reuse.
